item.tib: mkha' klong gsang ba'i mdos chen gyi bca' thabs gsal byed nyi 'od
item.coloph: zhes rje rin po ches mdzad pa'i gsang mdos kyi khams sogs dang 'bru sogs spun sogs shing sogs kyi lag len so sor bshad pa dang / mkhas grub g.yung drung tshul khrims kyis mdzad pa'i sprad khrig zhang ston gyis mdzad pa'i phyag len rnams gtsor bton gzhan yang mkhas pa du mas bsgrigs pa'i bca' gzhi lag khrig rnams nas kyang / lung dang mthun zhing dgos gnad che ba'i legs cha rnams tshangs par byas pa'i bca' thabs gsal byed 'di yang / dbang ldan zhu'i khri skyong g.yung drung dbang rgyal gyis bka'is yang yang bskul ba la brten nas/ zhu yi rus thob sgrub rgyud nyam (skam)zhig gi bla ming pa nyi ma bstan 'dzin dbang gi rgyal por 'bod pas sman ri'i bla brang du sbyar ba dge bas g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa dar rgyas su 'phel ba'i rgyu gyur cig/
